body:
## What it does

The anniversary, the restaurant you meant to book, the present you meant to order: it holds all of that and raises each one while there is still time to do something. The looking-up and the shortlisting happen for you, so your effort goes into the gesture instead of the arrangements. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @dannybuck shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
